headline: IMF Staff Approves Third Review of Argentina Program for $900M Disbursement
summary: IMF staff approved the third review of Argentina's economic program, clearing the way for a potential $900 million disbursement.
why: IMF financing agreements and disbursements are crucial for maintaining Argentina's foreign currency reserves and meeting sovereign debt obligations.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Successful IMF reviews and loan disbursements improve sovereign liquidity and ease default fears.

why_moved: Approval of the economic review signals adherence to program targets, unlocking fresh funds to support central bank reserves.
